title: Short-complex comparison for the graded augmented cone
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $I$ a bicomplex with complex index $s\in\mathbf Z$ and resolution index $r\in\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total], and $a:K[0]\to I$ a bicomplex map, where $K[0]$ concentrates each $K^s$ in resolution degree zero. Let $b\in\mathbf Z$ and suppose $I^{s,\bullet}=0$ and $K^s=0$ for $s<b$. Let $J$ be the identity-mapped, extended-by-zero and flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation], and let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map whose component in degree $n$ is $a^{n,0}$ followed by the extension identification and the $(0,n)$ diagonal inclusion. Set $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$, using the mapping cone of [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic], with canonical inclusions $u_n:K^{n+1}\to C^n$ and $v_n:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n\to C^n$. Let $F$ be any decreasing subcomplex filtration of $C$ [def-sp-filtration] whose degreewise steps satisfy [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] $F^pC^n=(\operatorname{im}(u_n)\text{ if }p\le n+1\text{, else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,p)}^n\operatorname{im}(J^{n-s,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n\xrightarrow{v_n}C^n)$. The sum is the finite supremum of image subobjects, with empty sum zero. For any integers $p,n$, there is an isomorphism of short complexes $\operatorname{sc}_n(\operatorname{gr}^p_F C)\cong\operatorname{sc}_{n-p}(\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(a^p)))$. Here $\operatorname{gr}^p_F C$ is the cokernel of the inclusion of subcomplexes $F^{p+1}C\to F^pC$ [def-sp-filtration], $\operatorname{sc}_m(L)$ is $L^{m-1}\xrightarrow{d} L^m\xrightarrow{d}L^{m+1}$, and extend is extension by zero from resolution indices in $\mathbf N$ to $\mathbf Z$. No bounds on the filtration, homology isomorphism, or quasi-isomorphism is asserted in this statement.

proof.text: For m<p-1, hF has an absent K summand and an empty diagonal interval, so the filtration step has zero image. Its monic inclusion then has zero source. The evaluated graded cokernel projection is epic, so its target is zero as well. Both column-cone terms vanish by extension by zero in negative resolution degrees. Use the isomorphism between zero objects; the normalization conditions are vacuous by arithmetic. This case is fully proved by the private Lean helper normalized_iso_all_degrees.
Apply the normalized degreewise quotient comparison at n-1, n and n+1, retaining its lift equations. This performs the finite image quotient and extension-by-zero object calculation.

Apply normalized differential compatibility to the adjacent pairs (n-1,n) and (n,n+1). These are compatible by arithmetic. Build the inverse comparison between the explicit three-term short complexes using Mathlib ShortComplex.isoMk and the inverse object isomorphisms. Use HomologicalComplex.isoSc' on either side to identify prev/next indices, then invert and compose the comparisons.

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_graded_shortComplex_iso
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      K ⟶ I)
    (b : ℤ)
    (hIbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (hKbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (K.X s))
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (haug : ∀ n : ℤ, aug.f n = (a.f n).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X n))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (zero_add n))
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n)))
    (p n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((F.gradedPiece p).sc n ≅
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (a.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).sc (n - p))
